text:
Nora: Heads-up — reconciliation found two invoices for AeroScale (acct AS-412) for May. One is full, the other is missing the promotional discount line (~$1,500).
Ethan: IDs and amounts?
Nora: INV-2024-05-3017 (full, $15,200.00) and INV-2024-05-3017-DLV (no promo, $16,700.00). The DLV draft was emailed to billing contact.
Sam: Oh no. Any payments recorded?
Ethan: Payment gateway shows one payment for $15,200 against INV-2024-05-3017. Good news: no double-charge.
BillingBot: [alert] invoice-renderer: email-sent INV-2024-05-3017-DLV to billing@aeroscale.com (job ir-6019)
Nora: Renderer logs show it picked the latest draft id rather than canonical. Snippet: 
```
2024-05-31T14:02:10Z INFO invoice_renderer job=ir-6019
2024-05-31T14:02:11Z INFO fetch_invoice id=INV-2024-05-3017-DLV status=draft
2024-05-31T14:02:12Z INFO render_pdf -> email
```
Sam: Root cause theory: delivery webhook retried and the generator created a delivery-suffix draft when transforms saw a transient missing promo_tag. The renderer then used that draft.
Ethan: Remediation steps: 1) mark INV-2024-05-3017-DLV do-not-send and void it, 2) send corrected PDF from canonical invoice, 3) add renderer guard to prefer invoices with linked_payments or without delivery suffix.
Nora: Filed ticket FIN-6440 for outreach + void. Attached logs and PDFs.
BillingBot: [info] FIN-6440 created by Nora assigned to Sam. SLA: 2 business days.
Sam: I'll draft a short customer note: "We sent an earlier draft that omitted your promotional discount. You were billed correctly; please see attached corrected invoice. Apologies for any confusion."
Ethan: I'll open a small PR to skip drafts with suffixes like '-DLV' or '-EMAIL' when a canonical paid invoice exists: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/invoice-renderer/pulls/1978
Nora: Also run a scan for other '-DLV' drafts emailed between 2024-05-28 and 2024-06-02. ES index: invoices-prod-2024-05. Post results to FIN-6440.
Ethan: Ran quick query — found 4 DLV drafts, 1 emailed (AeroScale). Uploading CSV to the ticket.
Sam: Thanks. After patch, schedule a cleanup job to revoke unpaid emailed drafts older than 5 days.
Nora: Putting hold on AeroScale sends until FIN-6440 is closed. Will update ticket when outreach sent. :thumbsup:
